title: performance(canary): automated detection and rollout guards for perf regressions
author: Aisha Patel
description: Summary: Adds automated performance-canary detection and rollout-guard logic to the canary orchestration pipeline. Motivation: reduce human reaction time for latency/throughput regressions when rolling out new runtime changes or model variants. This PR implements: (1) a detector that continuously computes per-route and per-model p50/p90/p95 latency, token throughput, and error-rate deltas against a rolling baseline; (2) hysteresis and sensitivity profiles to avoid flapping (configurable per-service); (3) rollout guards that automatically pause or rollback a canary when thresholds are exceeded for a sustained window; (4) integration with the canary control plane UI + alerting so SREs can inspect signal graphs and manually override; (5) a new perf-canary CI job that runs a lightweight synthetic workload to validate detector logic on changes. Design notes: - Baseline windows: 60m rolling median baseline; comparison window: 5m aggregation with configurable min-sample checks. - Metrics used: p95 latency, 99th token-tail latency, token throughput (tokens/sec), 5xx-rate. - Detection: computes relative and absolute regressions; thresholds are defined per-metric and per-service; regressions must persist for N consecutive windows (configurable) to trigger action. - Hysteresis: backoff timers and adaptive thresholds to avoid noisy aborts during transient spikes. - Actions: pause canary, rollback to previous stable variant, open incident runbook and post a summary to the canary channel with diffs. - Observability: we emit canary.detector.{metric}.{status} counters and a canary.alert event with structured tags to link to traces. - Tests: unit tests for detector logic, integration tests exercising the control-plane action path (mocking runtime), and an end-to-end perf-canary job that runs in CI. Migration: existing canary configs are backward-compatible; new fields are optional and default to conservative sensitivity. Impact: reduces mean time-to-detect regressions and automates safe rollback for clear perf regressions. See linked Linear tickets for rollout plan and SRE runbook.
